title: $2 off $15, $4 off $30, $9 off $65, $15 off $120, $25 off $209, $40 off $329, $55 off $449 Spend (in USD) @ AliExpress
body:
Deal: $2 off $15, $4 off $30, $9 off $65, $15 off $120, $25 off $209, $40 off $329, $55 off $449 Spend (in USD) @ AliExpress

[PainToad] AliExpress sales be like https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HpkecYVRt_E
[UncleRico] Quite. You, sir, are the Wiz…
https://youtu.be/ZtjI0tDLr3A?t=35
[Clear] I used to hate Seinfield. It's only since I've grown old and started getting grey hair that I've appreciated it.
[Lizard Spock] @Clear: On the contrary. I used to love watching Seinfeld in my late teens. Now I can't-stand-za, sorry, I can't stand Jerry, he makes me cringe so much. The other actors on the show are just brilliant, each one selected perfectly for their character.
[UncleRico] I suspect he's referring to an additional third party cashback from TopCashback or ShopBack, which @Clear so often procures…
[UncleRico] @Clear: Yep. Sounds like you've already got something up your sleeve. Love your work…
[UncleRico] Thanks @Clear!
Hopefully the cashback team will be up to 5 or 10% by then, ahead of our last chance to get some good AM4 CPU and component deals before Black Friday / Cyber Monday sales…
[SBOB] Hoping for discounts on Li-ning running shoes..
[HolyFosh] Hoping to see a solid discount on the Poco X8 Pro
[dottjt] Bit random, but I just discovered pocketable eink readers. Would be great if we could get a deal on the xteink X3! Let's start a trend ;)
[Clear] Very niche and I can see people already saying "Get a kindle". I reckon around US$50 will be realistic.
[dottjt] I think they were only released last year and now a whole bunch of other companies are making their version now with the success of this. It's basically a great way to replace doomscrolling - I tried many different things, but using my phone ereader has broken the cycle. I think these will gain traction over time.
It's just now that it's in a phone-sized form factor, you can easily bring it in anywhere and use it like you would your phone.
[Chazzozz] On the contrary, I much prefer my Kobo Clara specifically because it’s slightly larger than my phone. It feels like reading is a purposeful activity rather than burning spare time on a phone-like device, and it’s still small enough it’ll fit into a jacket pocket or a bag very easily. (I know it’s more expensive than the one you’re looking at but it was a gift so I didn’t choose it. The argument would still hold if I was looking to purchase something for myself, though.)
[dottjt] @Chazzozz: Reading can be both a purposeful activity as well as a burning spare time activity. Like, if I'm sitting on the dunny I'm going to grab something to preoccupy my mind. Usually that's my phone, which is what's in my pocket. I'm not going to go out of my way to get the ereader (especially if I'm out in public/at work/at the gym etc.) let alone if I have it with me. This is where the pocketable ereader would come in handy.
[Shon] Own a X4 (dropped and broke the screen), X3 and X4 pro. Can't rate them highly enough. Oh and a Seeed Studio Sticky. I might have a problem…
[Low Punt] It’s quite funny that I’ll leave all this 50c junk in my cart to get $2 off $15 and perhaps another 10% off; get sweaty AF and salty when I have tracking problems then buy an $8 coffee cos I’m kinda bored whilst waiting for my partner.
[djz] Anyone else noticed how annoying the AliExpress website has become? They’ve turned into Temu on annoyance scale.
Constant pop ups, constant annoying sale banners, even just to go and track your order and they use all sort of dark patterns to give you 5% of the screen for your tracking info while shoving more items and sales into your eyeballs.
It’s a real shame because the product selection is amazing but between the ridiculous amounts of sale pitching and with the extremely shady pricing system it’s just becoming unbearable. Sick of seeing fake prices for first time users when I’m logged in and it knows I’ve bought from there many times before but still
[Low Punt] Agree. It’s not as bad as Temu though. I’m not sure how anyone can even use that site.
[lostinsydney] Anyone else got Elite 5% discount? I had this for few weeks now.
